parties.respondent: Paramjit Kaur Panesar @ Ajinder Kaur Panesar

summary: Irretrievable breakdown of marriage as ground for divorce under Article 142; cruelty and desertion claims under Hindu Marriage Act 1955; standard of proof for mental cruelty; age of parties (87 and 82 years); precedent from Naveen Kohli and Shilpa Sailesh; failure to establish statutory grounds; matrimonial discord from 1984 separation; High Court upheld; no divorce granted.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding marriage validity confirmed.
